name: pace-band
description: /pace: how fast the 5-hour and weekly limits are spent against their time, when each runs out at this rate, and the context by category. The last turn's cost on the mod's status line; a band above the prompt only to act on: a limit that runs out before its reset, a compact button. A Claude Code mod; companion to pace-statusline.

language.title: Language
language.description: For /pace and the pace-statusline line. auto follows Claude Code's own Language setting (/config); en or ru pins one. /pace en|ru|auto sets it too.
